requirement: The thr_mgmt component shall keep the speed output within the commanded flight-management range. The speed value shall be greater than or equal to -100 and less than or equal to 100 whenever thr_mgmt produces a speed value.

The thr_mgmt component shall keep the angle output within the commanded flight-management range. The angle value shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100 whenever thr_mgmt produces an angle value.

The thr_throttle_simulation component shall accept only bounded speed commands from the flight-management process. The speed input shall remain greater than or equal to -100 and less than or equal to 100.
The thr_yaw_simulation component shall accept only bounded angle commands from the flight-management process. The angle input shall remain greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.
The thr_mgmt component shall coordinate its numeric outputs so that a negative speed command is never paired with a positive angle command. If speed is less than 0, then angle shall be equal to 0.
The thr_mgmt component shall constrain high-speed manoeuvres. If speed is greater than 80, then angle shall be less than or equal to 30.
The thr_mgmt component shall produce a neutral angle when the commanded speed is zero. If speed is equal to 0, then angle shall be equal to 0.
The thr_mgmt component shall limit reverse flight commands. If speed is less than 0, then speed shall be greater than or equal to -30.
The thr_throttle_simulation component shall treat the boundary value -100 as the minimum admissible speed command and the boundary value 100 as the maximum admissible speed command.
The thr_yaw_simulation component shall treat the boundary value 0 as the minimum admissible yaw angle and the boundary value 100 as the maximum admissible yaw angle.

The Ardupilot_Code process shall route the speed command generated by prs_mgmt to prs_throttle without changing its numeric range; the speed command delivered to prs_throttle shall remain between -100 and 100.
The Ardupilot_Code process shall route the angle command generated by prs_mgmt to prs_yaw without changing its numeric range; the angle command delivered to prs_yaw shall remain between 0 and 100.
The door_handler component shall report a locked door only when the door is closed, latched, and locked. If closed, latched, and locked are true, then door_locked shall be true.
The door_handler component shall not report a locked door while any required locking condition is false. If closed is false or latched is false or locked is false, then door_locked shall be false.
The door_handler component shall command the lock actuator only after the door is closed and latched. If closed and latched are true, then lock shall be true.
The door_handler component shall inhibit the swivel actuator while the door is already locked. If locked is true, then swivel shall be false.
The door_handler component shall issue a pressure warning when the aircraft is in flight and the door is not closed. If in_flight is true and closed is false, then warn_diff_pres shall be true.
The door_handler component shall issue a slide warning during emergency evacuation when the door is not latched. If emergency_evacuation is true and latched is false, then warn_slide shall be true.
The door_handler component shall send warning information whenever either door warning output is active. If warn_diff_pres is true or warn_slide is true, then warning_info shall be true.
The door_handler component shall send ECAM information whenever the door is not in the fully secured state. If door_locked is false, then ecam_info shall be true.
The doors_int component shall combine the two door lock indications into a common closed-and-locked output. The cll output shall be true when door1 and door2 are both true.
The doors_int component shall keep the common closed-and-locked output false when either door lock indication is false. If door1 is false or door2 is false, then cll shall be false.
The doors_process component shall command D1_lock only when D1_closed and D1_latched are true and D1_emergency_evacuation is false.
The doors_process component shall command D2_lock only when D2_closed and D2_latched are true and D2_emergency_evacuation is false.
The doors_process component shall raise D1_warning_info when D1_warn_diff_pres or D1_warn_slide is true.
The doors_process component shall raise D2_warning_info when D2_warn_diff_pres or D2_warn_slide is true.
The doors_process component shall keep Mix_cll true only when the first door and the second door are both reported locked.
The doors_process component shall not command D1_swivel while D1_locked is true.
The doors_process component shall not command D2_swivel while D2_locked is true.
The doors_process component shall raise D1_ecam_info whenever D1_closed is false or D1_locked is false.
The doors_process component shall raise D2_ecam_info whenever D2_closed is false or D2_locked is false.
The door_management system shall preserve the closed-and-locked indication from doors_process to OCU. If process_door.Mix_cll is true, then the OCU cll input shall be true.
The WaterLevelMonitoring component shall encode the water alarm output as a bounded integer alarm value. WaterAlarm shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1.
The MethaneMonitoring component shall keep the reported methane level within the sensor range. MethaneLevel shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.
The PumpCtrl component shall emit a water alarm value within the same alarm range used by WaterLevelMonitoring. WaterAlarm shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1.
The PumpCtrl component shall require methane input values to stay within the monitored range. MethaneLevel shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.
The PumpCtrl component shall require water-level input values to stay within the monitored range. WaterLevel shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.
The WaterAlarm component shall accept only encoded alarm values from PumpCtrl. WaterAlarm shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1.

The PumpCtrl component shall force the water alarm output high when the water-level input reaches the high-water threshold. If WaterLevel is greater than or equal to 80, then WaterAlarm shall be equal to 1.
The PumpCtrl component shall keep the water alarm output low while the water-level input is below the low-water threshold. If WaterLevel is less than 50, then WaterAlarm shall be equal to 0.

The Nav_Stab_Control_Proc component shall assume that pressure input P_Input remains inside the calibrated pressure range. P_Input shall be greater than or equal to 0.0 and less than or equal to 1100.0.

The Nav_Stab_Control_Proc component shall assume that temperature input T_Input remains inside the avionics operating range. T_Input shall be greater than or equal to -50 and less than or equal to 80.
The Nav_Stab_Control_Proc component shall assume that compass input Compas_Input is a heading in degrees. Compas_Input shall be greater than or equal to 0.0 and less than 360.0.
The Nav_Stab_Control_Proc component shall assume that air-speed input V_Air_Input is nonnegative and bounded. V_Air_Input shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 120.
The navigation_task component shall constrain its desired altitude output to a nonnegative flight command. Altitude_Desiree_Output shall be greater than or equal to 0.0.
The navigation_task component shall limit its desired altitude output to the configured ceiling. Altitude_Desiree_Output shall be less than or equal to 1000.0.
The altitude_control_task component shall assume that Altitude_Desiree_Input is within the navigation command range from 0.0 to 1000.0.
The altitude_control_task component shall keep Montee_Desiree_Output within the climb-rate command range from -20.0 to 20.0.
The climb_control_task component shall assume that Montee_Desiree_Input remains greater than or equal to -20.0 and less than or equal to 20.0.
The stabilisation_task component shall not receive an empty infrared stream command; IR_Input shall be treated as an available data input whenever the component is evaluated.
The Nav_Stab_Control_Proc component shall require manual-mode radio commands only through MCU1_Data_Input and shall keep Trans_MCU0_Output within the inter-MCU message interface.
The Nav_Stab_Control_Proc component shall forward ground-station reporting only through Trans_Sol_Output and shall keep the reporting path separate from the MCU0 transfer path.
The send_data_to_autopilot_task component shall not consider the radio both available and really lost at the same time. Radio_Ok_Input and Radio_Really_Lost_Input shall not both be true.
The send_data_to_autopilot_task component shall send data to the autopilot only when Radio_Ok_Input is true or Radio_Really_Lost_Input is false.
The RecepteurCde_PilotageServo component shall keep Cde_Elevator_Output within the servo command range from -10000 to 10000.
The RecepteurCde_PilotageServo component shall keep Cde_MotorL_Output within the servo command range from -10000 to 10000.
The RecepteurCde_PilotageServo component shall keep Cde_MotorR_Output within the servo command range from -10000 to 10000.
The RecepteurCde_PilotageServo component shall keep Cde_AileronL_Output within the servo command range from -10000 to 10000.
The RecepteurCde_PilotageServo component shall keep Cde_AileronR_Output within the servo command range from -10000 to 10000.
The RecepteurCde_PilotageServo component shall keep Cde_Rudder_Output within the servo command range from -10000 to 10000.
The Interruption_Envoi_Servo component shall keep Data_Output within the Base_Types::Integer_16 servo range from -32768 to 32767.
The Interruption_SPI_MCU1 component shall keep Data_Rec_MCU1_Output available as the data received from the MCU1 SPI interrupt path.

The RecepteurCde_PilotageServo component shall generate aileron commands symmetrically when both aileron outputs are required to hold neutral flight. If Cde_AileronL_Output is equal to 0, then Cde_AileronR_Output shall be equal to 0.
The RecepteurCde_PilotageServo component shall generate balanced motor commands during neutral throttle. If Cde_MotorL_Output is equal to 0, then Cde_MotorR_Output shall be equal to 0.
The Computation_Th component shall keep Data_Out within the computed integer range from 0 to 100.
The Producer_Th component shall assume that Data_In remains inside the producer input range from 0 to 100.
The Producer_Th component shall keep Pr_Index nonnegative whenever it emits an index value.
The Producer_Th component shall keep Pr_Index less than 4 whenever it emits an index value for the consumer queue.
The Consumer_Th component shall accept only Cr_Index values that select an element in the four-entry queue. Cr_Index shall be greater than or equal to 0 and less than 4.
The A component shall keep Alpha3 within the index range from 0 to 3.
The B component shall assume that Beta3 remains within the index range from 0 to 3.
The A component shall expose Alpha3 as the producer index and shall keep Alpha3 equal to Pr_Index whenever the producer emits an index.
The B component shall deliver Beta3 to the consumer index input and shall preserve the same index range required by Consumer_Th.
The PC_Simple system shall preserve the integer index path from pr_A.Alpha3 to pr_B.Beta3 without changing its 0 to 3 range.
The sensor_temperature_thread component shall keep tempout within the measured temperature range from -50 to 150.
The partition1_process component shall keep samplingout within the same measured temperature range from -50 to 150.
The partition2_process component shall assume that samplingin remains within the measured temperature range from -50 to 150.
The commandboard_receiveinput_thread component shall assume that temp remains within the measured temperature range from -50 to 150.
The partition1_process component shall preserve the sampled temperature from temperature.tempout to samplingout within the -50 to 150 range.
The arincsystem component shall preserve the sampling connection from partition1_pr.samplingout to partition2_pr.samplingin within the -50 to 150 range.
The speed component shall keep sp within the allowed speed range from 0 to 100.
The speed component shall initialize sp to 0 before any tick-driven update is observed.
The speed component shall never produce a negative sp value.
The speed component shall cap sp at 100 whenever repeated tick events would otherwise increase the value beyond the allowed range.
The Pression device shall keep P_Output within the pressure sensor range from 0.0 to 1100.0.
The Tension device shall keep T_Output within the supply-voltage range from 0 to 127.
The Compas device shall keep Compas_Output within the heading range from 0.0 to less than 360.0.
The Vitesse_Air device shall keep V_Air_Output within the air-speed range from 0 to 120.
The GPS device shall provide GPS_Output only through its declared event data port and shall not mix GPS data with infrared stream data.
The InfraRed device shall provide IR_Output through the declared stream-element data interface.
The Compteur device shall keep Data_Elev_Output equal to Data_Elev_Input whenever the elevator command is forwarded.
The Compteur device shall keep Data_AilL_Output equal to Data_AilL_Input whenever the left aileron command is forwarded.
The Compteur device shall keep Data_AilR_Output equal to Data_AilR_Input whenever the right aileron command is forwarded.
The Compteur device shall keep Data_MotorL_Output equal to Data_MotorL_Input whenever the left motor command is forwarded.
The Compteur device shall keep Data_MotorR_Output equal to Data_MotorR_Input whenever the right motor command is forwarded.
The Compteur device shall keep Data_Rudder_Output equal to Data_Rudder_Input whenever the rudder command is forwarded.
The Servo device shall assume that Data_Input remains within the Integer_16 servo command range from -32768 to 32767.
The Recepteur device shall forward radio-control event data from RC_Input to RC_Output without changing the declared Papa_Types::Unknown interface.
